name: Viral Choke
description: That moment. On stage. Lights on you. And nothing comes out. Now it's everywhere.

chapters.title: It's Everywhere
chapters.description: The video dropped. Someone edited together a compilation of just your choke - 45 seconds looped with sad music. It has 500k views. The comments are brutal. Other battlers are posting it with clown emojis. Your phone won't stop buzzing.

choices.label: Own It
choices.description: Post it yourself with a caption: 'Yeah I choked. It happens. Next battle I'm coming different.'

choices.label: Make Excuses
choices.description: Post about being sick, family issues, mic problems - anything but 'I forgot my bars.'

choices.label: Go Dark
choices.description: Delete social media. Don't respond. Disappear until it blows over.

chapters.title: Respect the Accountability
chapters.description: Some people respect that you owned it. Others say you're just doing damage control. Either way, the memes aren't stopping. Your next opponent is already using it in their promo.

choices.label: Address It On Stage
choices.description: Your next battle, use it. 'Yeah I choked, but I'm still here. What's your excuse?'

choices.label: Let the Work Speak
choices.description: No more talking about it. Just show up and perform.

chapters.title: Nobody's Buying It
chapters.description: People saw through the excuses. Now you're a 'choker AND a liar.' Someone even pulled up old footage of you looking fine before the battle. The narrative got worse.

choices.label: Double Down
choices.description: Keep insisting there were circumstances. Maybe some people will believe you.

choices.label: Finally Come Clean
choices.description: Admit you made excuses because you were embarrassed. Real talk.

chapters.title: The Silence Is Loud
chapters.description: Your silence is being interpreted as guilt, weakness, or worse - that you quit. Leagues are wondering if you're still active. Some fans think you retired.

choices.label: Announce Your Return
choices.description: Post that you're back and ready. Book a battle immediately.

choices.label: Take More Time
choices.description: You're not ready. Give it another month.

chapters.title: The Pressure Battle
chapters.description: Everyone's watching your next battle. Will you choke again? The venue is packed. Opponents are in the crowd hoping to see you fail. This is your moment.

choices.label: Leave Nothing in the Chamber
choices.description: Prepare like your career depends on it. Because it might.

choices.label: Treat It Like Any Other Battle
choices.description: Don't overthink it. You've done this before. Just be yourself.

chapters.title: Back to Work
chapters.description: You're not addressing the choke. You're just battling. Some respect it. Others think you're avoiding the elephant in the room. Either way, you're in the ring again.

choices.label: Focus on Winning
choices.description: Stack W's. Let the record speak for itself.

choices.label: Book a Big Name
choices.description: A win over someone major will make people forget the choke.

chapters.title: Coming Back Cold
chapters.description: It's been a while. You haven't battled. Haven't written much. The rust is real. But the pressure is off - people stopped talking about you. That's not necessarily good.

choices.label: Small Room Comeback
choices.description: Start in a small league. Build back up slowly.

choices.label: Big Stage Return
choices.description: Come back where you left. Main stage. All eyes.

endings.title: Redemption
endings.description: You came back hard. Really hard. People are calling it one of your best performances ever. The choke is now part of your comeback story. 'Remember when he choked? Look at him now.'

endings.title: Moved On
endings.description: You didn't make a big deal about it. Just kept battling. The choke faded into your past. It's mentioned sometimes, but it doesn't define you.

endings.title: Quiet Comeback
endings.description: Three wins in a row. No drama. Just results. The narrative slowly changed from 'the guy who choked' to 'the guy who's been winning lately.'

endings.title: Statement Made
endings.description: You beat a big name. Decisively. The choke video still exists, but now there's a new video people are posting - the one where you bodied a legend.

endings.title: Slow Rebuild
endings.description: You're working your way back up. The small rooms are humbling but helpful. You're relearning how to battle without the pressure. It's a longer road, but maybe the right one.

endings.title: All or Nothing
endings.description: You came back on the big stage after a long break. Either you'll prove yourself or dig a deeper hole. The battle hasn't happened yet, but you've committed. No turning back.

endings.title: Excuse King
endings.description: You're known for excuses now as much as the choke. Every time you lose, people expect an excuse. The 'what's his excuse this time' memes are worse than the choke memes.

endings.title: Permanently Labeled
endings.description: It's been a year. You're still 'the guy who choked.' It's the first thing mentioned when your name comes up. The video gets reposted every anniversary. You can't escape it.
